title: Bane (deity)
html:
Bane

Lord of Darkness

Voice / Actor

  • David Rintoul

Faction

Dead Three & Cult of the Absolute

Stats

Race

Deity
Bane, also known as the Lord of Darkness, is the god of tyranny, hate, strife, and a member of the Dead Three. He is associated with the domains of Order and War. Bane cannot be the deity of a player character Cleric.
“
I am Bane, The Black Lord. I am the Ultimate Tyrant. I am Fear, I am Hate.
„
— Bane

Revelations

Act Two

 Enver Gortash is revealed to be Bane's Chosen. In the Mind Flayer Colony underneath Moonrise Towers, Gortash is accompanied by  Orin the Red and  Ketheric Thorm. It is discovered that the Dead Three – Bane,  Bhaal, and  Myrkul – have once again formed an alliance to have their chosen create the Cult of the Absolute. Using his  Netherstone, the Edict of Bane, Gortash issues the order to the Netherbrain to march the Absolute's armies on Baldur's Gate.

Act Three

If Enver Gortash is fought, he can call to Bane for aid. If called, Bane transforms Gortash into the  Avatar of Tyranny. If  Speak with Dead is used on Enver Gortash, Bane responds in his stead – stating that Gortash's soul is now suffering at his hands for failing him.

Cult of Bane

Ranks in the cult from highest to lowest:

  • Black Gauntlet of Bane
  • Iron Consul of Bane
  • Fist of Bane
